questions.q: Recite «تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ» (105:4) and name the rule.
questions.a: Ikhfa shafawi: lips lightly closed and a two-count hum before ب.

questions.q: How long is the ghunnah in ikhfa shafawi?
Hum check: today's rota group recites 96:14 and 105:4 to the teacher. Everyone else: find the ikhfa shafawi in Al-'Adiyat 100:11 on the pupil PDF.
Extend: write the difference between iqlab and ikhfa shafawi in one sentence.
questions.a: Iqlab starts with a noon or tanween; ikhfa shafawi starts with a meem. Both are hummed before ب.

questions.q: Stretch: recite Al-'Alaq 96:14 to 19 with every rule correct.
questions.a: Clear recitation with ikhfa shafawi in 96:14 and qalqalah in 96:19.
A) يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ. Meem sakinah before ب. أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ is izhar shafawi; مِنْ عَلَقٍ is a noon rule (izhar).

questions.q: Think again: Iqlab turns a noon into a meem before ب. Ikhfa shafawi starts with a real meem before ب. Do you think they will sound the same?
questions.a: Yes, they sound the same: lips closed, two-count hum. Only the starting letter is different.
